summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not redistribution, storage, derivatives, public display, alerts, affiliate, advertising, image, price, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights; current public terms restrict the proposed uses. Four launch-readiness tasks remain open; none is closable. Compliance is technical-only: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown. Security, accuracy, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required before any permission request or rights-dependent launch decision. Do not send outreach or change launch, monetization, tracking, credentials, configuration, or alert scope.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Progress is evidenced by official Woot API, terms, and support records; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft terms. No task is closed because rights, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4, vendor, incident, accuracy, freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep outreach unsent.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked; missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional privacy review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, retention, access, incident, and request-procedure inventory.

Revenue and attribution remain evidence-limited. Amazon data covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The commission is aggregate and unattributed; do not assign it to a site or claim revenue, margin, ROI, payback, forecast, or causal lift. Continue only the existing reconciliation and preserve missing costs, budgets, commitments, and learning thresholds as unknown.

Retain the private launch gate for security-sensitive exposure. Fleet-doctor, operations sweeps, and material access, secrets, isolation, release, dependency, TLS, monitoring, incident, and disclosure controls remain unevidenced. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional only within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, and data boundaries. Continue the existing read-only evidence matrix without production, credential, permission, dependency, deployment, or outreach changes.
